description: A single brown sneaker sits on a tabletop in the corner, with its laces spread out in front. The left hand and right hand both grasp the lace ends as a two-hand object, pull them outward to tighten, then cross and loop the laces while alternating grips; both hands work close together above the tongue to form the bow, and finally they pull the loops apart and release, leaving the shoe neatly tied.
